title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Flens-Arena, Flensburg | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Flens-Arena in Flensburg, Germany, on 9 June 2018.

Yes it’s all you need is love Saturday peace and love peace and love. ????????????? pic.twitter.com/FmJ331XOnC

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) June 9, 2018

It was the fifth show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
